title: crepis sancta subsp. glaucescens
intro: Crepis sancta subsp. glaucescens, commonly known as the holy hawk's beard, is a plant species in the dandelion family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce pain, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Crepis sancta subsp. glaucescens include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve digestion, and exhibit antibacterial and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
